description: Official MM baseline, current universe, licensing and official IDs remain pending; this is a research draft only. The recovered 2015 codebook is not an official 2023 baseline.
required_followup: Coordinator review against official baseline and licensing/universe once available.

description: Affected L’Orient-Le Jour/L’Orient Today hold prevents body review of alternate Jan. 9–17 teacher, depositor, vehicle-importer and public-sector items. This leaves the listed events without L’Orient-based independent corroboration; open MTV/National bodies, where available, are the evidence actually used.
required_followup: Only coordinator-permitted exact-scope/origin review or independently available sources; do not retry these held URLs or infer publisher variants.

description: Exact body requests for Anadolu Agency Jan. 26 teacher report and Naharnet Jan. 14 port-activist protest returned internal tool errors / “not accessible via this tool,” with no HTTP status. These are technical gaps, not observed denials.
required_followup: No retries or variants; proceed only from separately permitted sources.

description: Jan. 9 Tripoli teachers sit-in has no headcount in opened body; no simultaneous threshold can be inferred from union size, nationwide strike notice or multiple locations.
required_followup: Independent contemporary local report with site-level simultaneous attendance, if available.

description: Jan. 9 Tripoli and Jan. 11 Beirut teacher gatherings occurred during the same national public-school strike, but whether they are separate protest episodes or multi-site phases of one organized action is unresolved. Strike alone is not a gathering; no automatic merger.
required_followup: Review event-level organizer, exact onset, and distinct action reporting; examine before/after months without duplicating strike-only activity.

description: Jan. 26 Justice Palace protest has an approximate “hundreds of families” count from one Arab News body; exact method and independent numerical count are absent.
required_followup: Reviewer may assess the approximate count and source independence; no further count conversion.

description: Several January leads mention multiple cities or road locations but no usable site-by-site count/relationship evidence; no aggregation across locations was performed.
required_followup: Only separately permitted contemporaneous reporting can establish specific site/events and simultaneous turnout.

description: Fourteen actual web searches were captured in English, French and Arabic. Coverage included broad Jan. 1–31 terms and targeted teacher, depositors, car-importer/public-sector and judicial-protest leads, but not a systematic archive or LexisNexis search; regional/sector coverage remains incomplete. Search returned many historical/unrelated results.
required_followup: Review any accessible national/local newspaper archives, sector-specific sources and late-month/early-month windows if further research time permits.

description: No opened report explicitly establishes physical end times/closure for Jan. 9, Jan. 11 or Jan. 26 protest gatherings; end dates remain unknown rather than assumed to equal report date or month-end.
required_followup: Contemporaneous event-ending or retrospective complete-activity account; absent that, keep end unknown.

description: State response and protester violence remain unknown where bodies do not report them; this is not zero or an inference of absence. Jan. 26 records only direct reported rock throwing, police pushback and batons.
required_followup: Event-specific reporting for any unreported response/violence fields.
